mechanism: Garlic may induce CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2C9), potentially reducing phenobarbital levels, though phenobarbital's auto-induction already dominates; additionally, garlic has mild antiplatelet properties that may be additive with phenobarbital's effects on hemostasis.
action: Monitor seizure control and consider phenobarbital level monitoring if garlic supplementation is initiated; counsel patient on consistent garlic intake to avoid fluctuating anticonvulsant levels.
